nodes.label: Tooling & Skill Routing
nodes.rationale: Routing guidance only - the product workflow is unchanged by anything here. Read the relevant SKILL.md before starting work in its domain; do not guess at a skill's contents from its name.

nodes.label: Docking Agent
nodes.rationale: Slow - background job. Docks surviving candidates and computes a composite rank score.

nodes.label: DUD-E Docking Sanity Check
nodes.rationale: Where a benchmark target with known actives/decoys exists, confirm known actives score better than decoys as a sanity check on the docking setup.

nodes.label: Evaluation Methodology
nodes.rationale: Use the field's actual benchmarks, not ad hoc judgment: validity, uniqueness, novelty, internal diversity, MOSES/GuacaMol, retrieval precision, and a DUD-E docking sanity check.

nodes.label: LangGraph Core Stages Workflow
nodes.rationale: intake -> literature ingestion -> KB indexing -> retrieval -> conditioned generation -> safety screening -> property filtering -> docking & ranking -> report assembly -> memory write. The Coordinator can re-enter the graph partway through.

nodes.label: Novelty = distance from nearest retrieved known compound
nodes.norm_label: novelty = distance from nearest retrieved known compound

nodes.label: Vision Agent
nodes.rationale: Slow - runs as a background job.

nodes.label: DockingResult Core Data Entity
nodes.rationale: Per-candidate docking pose, affinity score, composite rank score and its formula version.

nodes.label: Molecule Detail View with 3D Pose Viewer
nodes.norm_label: molecule detail view with 3d pose viewer
nodes.rationale: Full property breakdown, 3D docking pose viewer, Report Agent rationale, save/export actions.

nodes.label: Reproducibility Requirement
nodes.rationale: Generation runs record the model checkpoint version and random seed so a result can be regenerated.

nodes.label: V7 Multi-Agent Orchestration via LangGraph
nodes.rationale: Wire the individually-working agents from V1-V6 into a real LangGraph workflow rather than separate endpoints called in sequence by the frontend.

nodes.label: AutoDock Vina
nodes.rationale: Open-source, the default docking engine.

nodes.label: DiffDock (future alternate backend)
nodes.rationale: Optional alternate docking backend - the product's second legitimate use of diffusion models (pose prediction, not generation).

nodes.label: Open Babel / MGLTools Prep
nodes.rationale: For receptor/ligand file preparation: PDB -> PDBQT conversion, adding hydrogens, assigning charges.

nodes.label: V8 Build Prompt: Report Agent & Notebook
nodes.norm_label: v8 build prompt: report agent & notebook

nodes.label: V5 Status (current HEAD)
nodes.rationale: V5 conditions diffusion on retrieval via seed-graph init, with explicit fallback below 0.3 Tanimoto. Next: V6 Docking & Composite Ranking.

nodes.label: MoleculeTable Shared Comparison Table
nodes.rationale: Sortable/filterable, generic rows, reused unchanged by V4 and V5 - the V6 ranked table should extend the same component.

nodes.label: Elevator Pitch and Honest Framing
nodes.rationale: Not a claim to discover real drugs - a faithful, benchmark-honest replication of the pattern real computational chemistry teams use, built as a real usable product rather than a research script.

nodes.label: Docking & Composite Ranking
nodes.rationale: The exact formula must be disclosed in the report and the UI, following the same transparency principle used for LexBook-AI's readiness estimates. Example starting formula: rank_score = 0.5 * normalized_docking_affinity + 0.3 * QED + 0.2 * novelty.

nodes.label: Dual-Use Safety Design
nodes.rationale: De novo generation carries real acknowledged dual-use risk. A structural screening pass blocks known toxic-scaffold/controlled-substance analogs rather than merely flagging them; there is no supported path to condition generation toward maximizing toxicity. Load-bearing, not boilerplate.

nodes.label: Asynchronous by Design
nodes.rationale: No request should block on a diffusion sampling run or a docking job.

nodes.label: Transparent Scoring Requirement
nodes.rationale: Every score shown to the user must be traceable to a disclosed formula or a named benchmark metric; no unexplained confidence:87% style outputs.

nodes.label: Things Never to Cut
nodes.rationale: RDKit property filtering, docking against a real target, retrieval with real citations, transparent/disclosed scoring, the dual-use safety screening pass, and an honest README that never implies a generated molecule has been validated as a real drug candidate.

nodes.label: V6 Docking & Composite Ranking
nodes.rationale: Turn generated candidates into ranked, actionable results. Sequenced after V5 so the diffusion core is proven; vision deliberately deferred to V9 so the highest-risk piece never gates a working product.

nodes.label: V9 Vision Agent Structure Extraction
nodes.rationale: Deliberately last among core capability versions - the highest-risk piece should not gate a working product.

nodes.label: Build in Versions, De-Risk the Hard Part Last
nodes.norm_label: build in versions, de-risk the hard part last
nodes.rationale: Prove the core retrieval -> generate -> filter -> dock -> report loop works end-to-end on already-structured data before touching the vision pipeline, so if vision turns out harder than expected the project still has something to show.

nodes.label: Celery + Redis Mandatory
nodes.rationale: Unlike LexBook-AI where it was optional. Structure extraction, diffusion sampling, and docking are all slow; these must run as background jobs with status polling, not inline in a request/response cycle.

nodes.label: V6 Build Prompt: Docking & Composite Ranking
nodes.norm_label: v6 build prompt: docking & composite ranking
nodes.rationale: Fetch and prepare the actual target structure (not just the stored PDB ID), dock as a Celery job, disclose formula + version in API and frontend, render 3D poses, and run a DUD-E sanity check if feasible. Ground rules: no LangGraph (V7), no Report Agent prose (V8), ask before adding a dependency not in tech-stack.md.

nodes.label: pdb_id Stored-String-Only Limitation
nodes.rationale: pdb_id is a stored reference string only - no structure fetch, no pocket handling. Full protein structure handling arrives with docking (V6). This is the exact gap V6 closes.

nodes.label: V1 Molecule Knowledge Base
nodes.rationale: Bulk PubChem/ChEMBL slice only - do not attempt full-database ingestion.

nodes.label: V3 Property Filtering Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Get filtering solid before adding generative complexity - cheap and immediately useful even without generation.

nodes.label: V4 Baseline Generative Agent
nodes.rationale: Prove the generative core works before layering the novel retrieval-augmented mechanism on top.

nodes.label: 3,417 ChEMBL Approved Drugs Corpus
nodes.rationale: Chosen because approved drugs are a defensible, citable, target-agnostic retrieval baseline.

nodes.label: Property Filtering Gate
nodes.rationale: Docking is the most expensive step - filter hard before it. Each filter's pass/fail and raw value is stored and shown per candidate, never collapsed into a single opaque good/bad flag.

nodes.label: RetMol-Style Retrieval-Augmented Diffusion
nodes.rationale: The technical core and direct analogue of LLM-RAG applied to a diffusion model: retrieved molecule embeddings projected into the conditioning space and injected during denoising, either as cross-attention context or as a guidance vector.

nodes.label: Fallback on Weak Retrieval
nodes.rationale: If no sufficiently similar known compounds exist, fall back to plain property-conditioned generation rather than forcing a conditioning signal from irrelevant molecules - and say so explicitly in the report.

nodes.label: V5 Retrieval-Augmented Generation
nodes.rationale: The technical core of the product - condition the diffusion model on retrieved known compounds.

nodes.label: Graph-DiT via torch-molecule (V4 backbone)
nodes.rationale: Chosen over EDM-3D because CPU sampling is feasible, MW/logP conditioning is native, and 2D fits both V5 conditioning paths. Chosen over the original DiGress repo because its published checkpoints are dead links.

nodes.label: V5 noise_steps Knob Proven but Bounded
nodes.norm_label: v5 noise_steps knob proven but bounded
nodes.rationale: The knob works (lower k moves outputs closer to the seed, 0.079 -> 0.128) without collapsing diversity, but absolute similarity stays low because QM9 caps at 9 heavy atoms. A ZINC-scale backbone would make the shift dramatic.
